desc: One-shot right-port physical-link proof after R0/R1/R2 and the complete class-10 detach decode pass. Build an exact right-HPM2-only host-transition artifact from reviewed upstream-derived operations: bounded HPM attach/source-role policy, VBUS only after passive-sink detection, eUSB2 repeater and T6040 ATC PHY sequence, then the already-proven right DART+xHCI no-root Linux smoke. Fixture must be the passive bus-powered USB memory stick; never a charger, powered dock, another host, or externally powered source. DebugUSB HPM0 remains untouched. Pass = child USB device remains present for 10 seconds, exact role/orientation/power transcript, no DART/SError/reset, followed by reviewed detach/rollback or reboot recovery. No filesystem mount or block write. Exact hashes, independent review, and explicit approval required.
